checks.text: The page heading is "Bill Splitter" and the tab labelled "Split" is active by default.

In the "Split" tab, typing "Dinner" in the field labelled "Description", "100" in the field labelled "Amount", and "Alice, Bob" in the field labelled "People" then clicking "Add expense" adds a row in the table labelled "Expenses" that contains "Dinner", "$100.00", and "Alice, Bob".
After adding the expense from A2, the result summary shows "Total: $100.00", "People: 2", and "Per person: $50.00".
In the "Split" tab, clicking the button labelled "Delete Dinner" removes the "Dinner" row from the "Expenses" table and the result summary shows "Total: $0.00", "People: 0", and "Per person: $0.00".

Adding two expenses, "Dinner" $100 with "Alice, Bob" and "Taxi" $50 with "Alice, Bob, Carol", the "Settle up" tab shows a table labelled "Transfers" with rows "Alice owes Bob $25.00" and "Alice owes Carol $25.00".

In the "Split" tab, changing the select labelled "Split mode" from "Even" to "Percentage" and entering "50" in the field labelled "Alice %" and "50" in the field labelled "Bob %" for the "Dinner" expense shows "Alice: $50.00" and "Bob: $50.00" in the breakdown.
Clicking the button labelled "Copy summary" copies the text "Total: $100.00, Alice: $50.00, Bob: $50.00" to the clipboard.
The "Split" tab shows a chart labelled "Share by person" with two bars, one labelled "Alice" and one labelled "Bob", each at 50% height.
Reload keeps the expense "Dinner" with amount "$100.00" and people "Alice, Bob" in the "Expenses" table.
